## Reviews
- Code review covered the complete task diff plus focused/full tests, typecheck, build, docs check, plan lint, and diff check. It found a post-commit index-refresh failure window; the ref now rolls back by compare-and-swap and a real index-lock test proves it.
- Security review covered agent argv/permissions, prompt and output bounds, hostile schema output, HTTP origin/size/attribution rules, path safety, concurrent locks, and Git state. It found lossy free-form entity slugs; new paths include a digest, exact legacy notes remain readable, and batches independently reject duplicate targets.
- Simplification review confirmed one record/parser/renderer/inventory/validation/commit path serves human edits, Codex, Claude, CLI, MCP, HTTP, context, and generated docs. Detailed results are in `evidence/reviews.txt`.

- The real local Codex and Claude executables were not allowed to mutate this task checkout; adapters were exercised through exact command/schema fixtures. The final `personal_website` acceptance batch will reveal executable-version or environment differences before program completion.
- Knowledge prose quality on a real repository remains intentionally unmeasured until the final confirmed `personal_website` generation run. Schema, coverage, staleness, and commit safety are proven here.
- The intermittent macOS fixture failure may recur independently of knowledge behavior; its intake item preserves the run and symptom for dedicated hardening.
